Greta's current daily driver

The Profitec Pro 300 + Niche Zero, on day 217

I've been pulling shots on this duo every morning since mid-November. The Pro 300 has earned its spot for one reason: it never gets in my way. Pre-heated and ready in 15 minutes, two PIDs that hold ±0.5°C, and a steam wand that actually rewards good technique instead of fighting it. Paired with the Niche Zero (still my single-dose pick), it's the closest I've come to "café shots at home" without spending café money.

Machine
Profitec Pro 300 (2024 rev., PID on both boilers)
Grinder
Niche Zero gen 3 — 63mm conical, single-dose
Beans
Heart Coffee "Stereo" blend, 14 days off roast
Recipe
18.5g in → 38g out in 30s, 93°C, 9 bar
Water
RPavlis recipe (potassium bicarbonate, 70 ppm)
